title: Fixed Twin Eccentric and Curved Slot Link
description: One complete newly authored fixed twin-eccentric curved-link mechanical exhibit. Two displaced complete discs share one transverse shaft in two bored pedestal bearings; each disc has its own full encircling annular strap and long connecting rod to a different end of a single thick curved slotted link. The curved link has a genuine continuous curved through opening and finite closed end bridges. A separate block occupies the middle slot, with its complete output stem offset in front of the link and passing through an independent bored guide on the common low grounded bed. A fixed rear support and actual visible pins keep the artistic arrangement coherent. Unlike the old direct-pin straight yoke there are paired eccentric straps and rods feeding a separate curved intermediary; unlike the old crosshead drive there is no piston chamber, flywheel or single rod directly driving a slider. All numeric geometry newly authored without old mesh imports. Three opaque PBR materials, metres Z-up and complete horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one static model zero scenes. Fixed artistic geometry only: no kinematic solution, valve timing, transmission, travel, mechanical ratio, fit, bearing motion, force, torque, manufacture, operation or engineering safety claim; no animation or interaction.
